perOriginalFindingVerdict.FIND-001: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED — evidence/tx-confirmations.txt exists with plausible, internally-consistent solana confirm -v transcripts for the original 5 tx sigs (balances/slots/program IDs cross-check cleanly), but this reviewer could not independently query devnet RPC to confirm them live (tool constraint, see FIND-005), AND the fix's evidentiary standard was not extended to the 2 new tx sigs the TRACE run later produced (see FIND-002).
perOriginalFindingVerdict.FIND-002: RESOLVED IN SLIDE 2, REGRESSED IN SLIDE 5 — Slide 2's fallback:true disclosure is honest and specific. But Slide 5 introduces a new overstatement ('all fixed and re-verified') that is false for the FIND-003 sub-bug per the builder's own trace-file admission. See FIND-001 (this round).
perOriginalFindingVerdict.FIND-003: MOSTLY RESOLVED, ONE SUB-ITEM HONESTLY STILL OPEN — the `??`->`||` code fix is present and correct in both telemetry.ts and complete.ts (verified by direct read); the trace file's ClawRouter-not-fallback evidence is real and specific (non-templated bid reasoning on both buyer and seller sides). The spec is honest that the fix itself was not re-verified live (matches this task's expectation) — but SUBMISSION.md (a different artifact) is NOT equally honest about this, see FIND-001.
perOriginalFindingVerdict.FIND-004: RESOLVED IN THE SUB-PACKAGE, NOT FORK-WIDE — coral-agents/seller-agent/coral-agent.toml and coral-agents/seller-agent/README.md are now accurate. examples/txodds/coral/README.md — the actual judge-facing file — was missed and is now internally self-contradictory (see FIND-003, this round).
perOriginalFindingVerdict.FIND-005: RESOLVED — telemetry.ts's comment now accurately describes what apps/landing/netlify/functions/_lib/telemetry-verify.js actually does (parses verbatim message bytes, recovers signer, runs telemetry-schema.js's validate()) — cross-checked directly against that file's real source and it matches. telemetry.test.ts's 'canonicalMessage field checklist' test is honestly labeled as a manual cross-reference, not a tautological byte-for-byte claim.
perOriginalFindingVerdict.FIND-006: RESOLVED — llm_buyer.ts's new doc-comment accurately discloses it is legacy/unused by the submitted CoralOS round; cross-checked against buyer-agent/src/index.ts, which indeed uses `complete()`/`pickWinner()` from @pay/agent-runtime directly, never LLMBuyerStrategy.
perOriginalFindingVerdict.FIND-007: RESOLVED, INDEPENDENTLY RE-CONFIRMED — this reviewer read solana_coralOS/.git/refs/remotes/origin/main directly (=f3c84eb25f7a40c39717413b03e75fc2d8378643), which matches the local HEAD reflog tip and, walking back through .git/logs/HEAD, all 5 originally-cited commit hashes (d9fc893, 7367721, 901a255, e6a32a8, ff7ead7) are present in the correct chronological order. This is real, on-disk git evidence, not a restatement of the builder's claim, though it is a local artifact rather than a live network query (tool constraint, see FIND-005).
perOriginalFindingVerdict.FIND-008: SAME EVIDENCE AS FIND-003 — the trace file's non-fallback JSON completions on both buyer and seller sides (provider=clawrouter model=eco, followed by real varying reasoning text, not the deterministic fallback shape) is genuine, specific, hard-to-fabricate-by-accident evidence that ClawRouter (not silent fallback) fired in the multi-agent round.
